 -2-  HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE P.NAVEEN RAO  AND  HON'BLE SMT Dr.JUSTICE G.RADHA RANI  WRIT PETITION No.37535 of 2021 ORDER:

(per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed seeking the following relief :
"...to issue a Writ or proceeding or order more particularly one in the nature of writ of Habeas Corpus directing to set aside the Detention Order passed by the 2nd respondent here in SB (I) No.286/PD- 6/HYD/2021, dated 24.09.2021 as approved Vali Ahmed Alias Baba vs The State Of Telangana on 24 February, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60253722/
1 by the 1st respondent in G.O.Rt.No.2083, General Administration Special Law and Order Department dated 13.09.2021 as arbitrary, illegal and unconstitutional and consequently direct to release the petitioner Detenue Vali Ahmed @ Baba S/o.Vali Farquddin, Aged 33 yrs, Occu : Carpenter R/o.H.No.7- 108/7, Indira Nagar,
Ramanthapur, Amberpet, Hyderabad 500 013 and pass such other or further orders ...."

2. This writ petition is deposed by the wife of detenu Vali Ahmed @ Baba, challenging the order of detention dated 24.09.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders,
Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders,
Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986).
3. Heard Sri Rachakonda Rama Krishna, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home representing learned Additional Advocate General.
4.

sentences.text: 5. Against the co-accused in the same crimes also orders of detention were passed on 24.09.2021.
Challenging the said detention orders W.P.Nos.32490 and 32525 of 2021 were filed on behalf of the co- accused.
This Court by order dated 17.02.2022 allowed the said writ petitions setting aside the orders of detention.

6. When the matter is called learned counsel for the petitioner as well learned Government Pleader submit that the subject matter of the writ petition is covered by the decision of this Court in W.P.Nos.32490 and 32525 of 2021.

7. Following the same, and for the reasons assigned therein, this writ petition is also allowed setting aside the impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Hyderabad City -2nd respondent vide SB (I) No.286/PD-6/HYD/2021 dated 24.09.2021 and the consequential confirmation order of the Principal Secretary to Government, General Administration (SPL.(Law &
Order) Department, Secretariat, Hyderabad-1st respondent confirming the detention vide G.O.Rt.No.2594, General Administration (SPL.(Law & Order) Department, dated 25.11.2021.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Vali Ahmed @ Baba S/o.late Mohd. Faqruddin,
Aged about 33 yrs, Occu : Plumber R/o.H.No.2-6-55/19/1, Indra Nagar, Ramanthapur, Amberpet,
Hyderabad at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The order of detention is passed on the allegation of involvement in Cr.No.243 of 2021 registered under Section 302, 201, 120 (B), 147, 148 r/w.Section 149 of Indian Penal Code of Chaderghat Police Station and Cr.No.294 of 2021 registered under Section 394 of Indian Penal Code of Afzalgunj Police Station.

This Court by order dated 17.02.2022 allowed the said writ petitions setting aside the orders of detention.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Vali Ahmed @ Baba S/o.late Mohd. Faqruddin,
